# Phase Three — Final Execution Plan

> Meaning is the chochmah spark, planning gives binah form, and verified execution is daas joining intent to the world Awtsmoos.com makes warm.

## Source pass one — code first

1. Re-read exact semantic-kernel factory signatures and Portal input/request signatures.
2. Create the smallest set of new `core/universalApi` modules needed for `createAwtsmoos`.
3. Rewrite the complete universal API barrel to export them while retaining all legacy exports.
4. Do not run tests until this first implementation draft is complete.

## Verification pass one

1. Run syntax/import/header/tab/line-count gates.
2. Add focused new tests as complete files.
3. Run new tests.
4. Run inherited authored-semantics debt tests.
5. Run core compatibility regression suites.
6. Fix failures only by full-file rewrites.

## Documentation/runtime pass

1. Create canonical API architecture/migration doc from verified behavior.
2. Create a noun-neutral example covering multiple semantic kinds and channel support states.
3. Inspect current public demo routes and deployment serving topology.
4. Create a small mobile-first public demo only if no suitable route exists.
5. Run browser/runtime verification.

## Closure pass

1. Reread every touched file.
2. Compare this plan with actual implementation and write `PLANNED_VS_ACTUAL_DELTA.md`.
3. Convert every important delta into work and resolve it.
4. Refresh Git reality and upstream.
5. Explicitly stage only mission files; inspect staged diff.
6. Commit, fetch, integrate concurrent upstream safely, rerun gates, push, verify remote SHA.
7. Deploy through the observed Awtsmoos immutable release mechanism.
8. Verify public route and deployed SHA/version in a fresh browser.
9. Empty `REMAINING_WORK.md` only if all completion evidence exists.
